page.layout: One printed page, rotated on the scan. Running head at top. Main text in a column left of centre, with a narrow left margin note column (beside the first diagram) and a right margin note column beside the diagram at the top. Two triangle diagrams inside the text column, with labels. Page number at top right.

main_text.l: reliquis autem lateribus quod in imo iacet appellant
angulum obtusum continet, atque adeo recto maiorem.
Vt in triangulo abc angulus ad a est
obtusus, id est, maior recto angulo, ergo
ad γ est obtusus, atq; adeo
Hypotenusa ὑποτείνουσα, id est, subtendo Cathetus ἀπὸ κάθετος, id est perpendiculariter demitto.

marginalia.note: Notetur isti termini propter doctrinam Astronomicam suo tempore plenius intelligendam sic ergo in triangulo rectangulo abc, ac est basis, ab est ὑποτείνουσα: cb est κάθετος seu perpendicularis

page.notes: Diagrams: first, a right triangle abc with labels Hypotenusa/Subtendens, Cathetus/perpendicularis, Basis, angulus rectus, oppositus angulo recto. Second, obtuse triangle with vertices a, b, c. Greek words in margin note are reproduced as legible; the right-margin note is a Greek/Latin gloss set in italic. Some words in the diagram labels are uncertain.
